dimensions.note: api_key (and private_key for the ssh transport) is sensitive-marked and travels only in the X-API-Key header: locally via fetch, remotely inside a curl config uploaded over the canonical _lib/ssh.ts stdin into a verified 0700 per-user cache directory and removed by a trap in the same remote shell (curl -q, proto =http,https). State and logs hold node, normalized api_url, ids, labels and counts, never the key. Live cell 10: ps sampled every 50 ms on the control host and both nodes found 0 hits for the keys, their substrings or SHA-256 (positive control hit); cache directories empty afterwards. Residual LOW (astra): remote curl stderr enters errors as its last line capped at 200 characters; curl does not echo header values there.
Each method logs once with structured placeholders (node, device, folder, changed); no key, header, argv or response body in log fields.

Non-2xx responses raise a typed SyncthingError carrying the status; 401/403 now say the API key was rejected (merge-prep message fix for the live cell 7 note). sync records unreachable only for a connect, DNS or timeout failure (ssh connect failure, curl exit 6/7/28, a classified fetch TypeError) and rethrows auth, TLS, 3xx, 5xx and code errors (live cells 7, 8, 9). Every OpenSSH exit 255 is a typed SshError; a host-key mismatch refuses to connect.

65 unit tests (model, REST client and the vendored transport) with injected fetch and ssh runners and a plain-object method context. Live end to end on two VPS nodes with Syncthing 1.27.2: 10/10 applicable cells on 3f038b4, including a real file sync between the nodes, PATCH preserving unmanaged fields, a stopped and a stalled API, a wrong key, a host-key mismatch and an argv scan.

ensure_device and ensure_folder read first, create with PUT and update with PATCH only on a declared-field difference, so unmanaged fields survive (live cell 4); repeats report changed false. remove_* is a no-op when absent, treats a DELETE 404 as already gone and confirms absence by re-reading. Requests are bounded by timeout_s (AbortSignal.timeout; curl max-time and connect-timeout).

Syncthing REST /rest/system/status and /rest/config/{devices,folders}, live-verified against syncthing 1.27.2. The ssh transport needs curl on the node; the API is reached at a loopback or HTTPS origin only.

The remote curl config lives only in a 0700 directory, is swept before each upload and removed by a trap in the shell that runs curl (live: 0 leftovers). Local temp files of the vendored transport are removed in finally; remote output is capped by the transport.

Manifest @randybias/syncthing-peer 2026.10.17.1 (model version literal matches), two-sentence description, Apache-2.0, additionalFiles README.md and LICENSE.txt. Fixtures use RFC 5737 addresses and synthetic keys; leak scan, gitleaks and fixture guard pass. Merge prep: plain model export so the registry catalogs the type. Residual LOW: no docs/specs spec for this extension.

Global arguments are an empty strictObject; method arguments are strict. api_url must be an origin (no userinfo, path, query or fragment; plain HTTP only on loopback) and is normalized before keying; device ids, folder ids (no . or ..), device addresses (dynamic or tcp/quic/relay host:port) and names/labels (printable-ASCII allowlist) carry grammars; api_key 8-128, timeout_s 1-600. Live cell 6: folder_id .. refused with no connection made.
node, device and folder resources: lifetime infinite, garbageCollection 10.
get/sync (read), ensure_device/ensure_folder (create/update) and remove_device/remove_folder (delete) cover devices and folders on one node.
api_url, ids, addresses, labels and host-key policy are validated before any request or ssh spawn; the remote config directory is verified (owner, not a symlink, mode 700) before upload.

syncthing-<32 hex>: SHA-256 over node label and normalized api_url, truncated to 128 bits; device and folder records append a length-prefixed id, so equivalent URLs share one record and ids cannot collide.
Methods read only this model's own records; every node, device and folder arrives as method arguments, so one definition serves any node.
First release. The vendored _lib/ssh.ts is the canonical blob fe0139f08c42e3fdae0061b9688fb5c534174957 (ssh-host 2026.10.17.2).
